name: codech-wp-security-maintenance
description: Security maintenance for live client WordPress sites from the application layer (WordPress MCP / wp-admin as the web user, no root): read-only audit, approval report, verified backups, custom-code and public-file fixes, one-at-a-time plugin updates with editor + sitemap checks, file-change monitor, site e-mail, Wordfence + 2FA rollout, changelog with undo for every change.
